result.name: QFORM-KRYLOV-FOOTPRINT-SPECTRAL-SQUARE-STABILITY-v1
result.statement: For symmetric A0,S, U=Ran(S), q=dim(U+A0U), every original-coordinate H and k+q<=|H| satisfy lambda_k(((A0+S)^2)[H,H])>=lambda_{k+q}((A0^2)[H,H]). If A=A0+S+R with ||R||op<=eps, then sqrt(lambda_k((A^2)[H,H]))>=(sqrt(lambda_{k+q}((A0^2)[H,H]))-eps)_+. Consequently an arbitrary signed spectral addition split at threshold h charges high modes only through q_h=dim(Ran(S_h)+A0 Ran(S_h)), and all remaining modes only through h.
